newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Byron 2, Ill. nuke seen up this week.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Byron 2, Ill. nuke seen up this week.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's (ComEd) 1,105 megawatt (MW) Byron, Ill., nuclear power unit 2 was expected to resume electricity output this week after a maintenance and refueling outage, a company spokesman said.
"It will definitely be back up this week," company spokesman Gary Wald said Tuesday.
The unit was taken off line August 8 for a 52-day refueling and maintenance.

Also, the company's 794 MW Dresden nuclear power unit 2 in Morris, Ill. was boosting output toward full power Tuesday after reducing output to about 78 percent of capacity Monday to service a water strainer problem, Wald said.
The unit was operating at 86 percent of capacity as of early Tuesday, the spokesman said.
The 794 MW Dresden unit 3 was boosting power, and was at 73 percent of capacity Tuesday morning, Wald said.
Dresden 3 is returning to full service from a maintenance and refueling outage which began June 21.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
